references.text: Refers to the 'princes' (נְשִׂיאֵי) as leaders over the tribes of Israel, the same group of leaders who are gathered with one trumpet in Num 10:4
Describes the princes of Israel (נְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל) as heads of their families and tribal leaders, the same group that was to be gathered at the sound of one trumpet
Mentions 'rulers over thousands' (שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים) as part of Israel's leadership structure, corresponding to 'heads over the thousands of Israel' in Num 10:4
Moses appoints 'rulers over thousands' as part of the people's organization, the same leadership structure referred to in Num 10:4
Explains that when both trumpets are blown, the entire assembly is to gather—in contrast to verse 4 where only one trumpet gathers the leaders
Mentions tribal princes and rulers over thousands as leaders in Israel, the same leadership structure as in Num 10:4
Refers to 'the heads of the thousands of Israel' (רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל) using identical terminology as in Num 10:4
Uses the expression 'the heads of the thousands of Israel' (רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל), the same designation as in Num 10:4
